thread:
ada: Quick micro-poll: what's everyone's go-to editor for quick fixes? Reply with an emoji or name. Options: :v: Vim, :vs: VSCode, :elephant: Emacs, :nut_and_bolt: Nano. Closing at 11:30 PT.
ben: VSCode :vs: — all the extensions.
chai: Vim :v: for life.
mina: Emacs :elephant: if I'm in deep editing mode.
ada: Nano :nut_and_bolt: when I'm ssh'd into a tiny VM. (ok joking but sometimes)
devbot: Pollbot summary: counted reactions and inline replies. Current tally: VSCode (1), Vim (1), Emacs (1), Nano (1).
ada: Tie! alright break the tie: favorite snack to pair with editing session? :coffee: coffee, :cookie: cookie, :apple: fruit, or surprise me.
ben: coffee + cookie combo.
chai: fruit — light and keeps me focused.
mina: cookie forever.
devbot: Final snapshot: Editors - VSCode (1), Vim (1), Emacs (1), Nano (1); Snacks - coffee (1), cookie (2), fruit (1).
ada: Pretty distributed. I'll put a tiny note in next week's watercooler that we should add a VSCode/Vim sticker pack to the office whiteboard. Also cookie run next Friday? :cookie:
mina: love that.
ben: stickers and cookies, sold.
chai: can we get both Vim and Emacs stickers for balance? :yin_yang:
ada: noted. thanks everyone for the quick votes!
